name: UNHOME
summary:
Survival is not living – and there is no break from the street. UNHOME is a 20-minute VR experience that immerses you in the reality of homelessness. From the first day of spring to the freezing nights of winter, four chapters tell a story of uncertainty, hardship, and fleeting moments of hope. 

Critical choices – whether to talk, seek help, or defend yourself – shape the journey but cannot overcome the structural barriers.
